items.headline: Google reveals Gemini 4 "Argon" to select cybersecurity partners
items.summary: Google unveiled its next flagship model, Gemini 4 Argon, saying it is state of the art on several coding and knowledge-work benchmarks and competitive with OpenAI's and Anthropic's top models. The company is granting early access only to trusted cybersecurity defenders while it completes additional safety testing.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol at a fifth of Astra's price
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol at its DevDay event, a mid-tier model that matches GPT-6 Astra on coding benchmarks while costing far less per token and cutting factual errors by about a third versus the prior Sol version.

items.headline: DeepSeek open-sources chip tools built for Huawei's Ascend platform
items.summary: DeepSeek released TileLang and related programming infrastructure for Huawei's Ascend chips, making it freely available in a move that could reduce China's AI industry reliance on Nvidia hardware.

items.headline: Anthropic's Claude for Government reaches general availability
items.summary: Claude for Government is now generally available to U.S. federal, state and local agencies through a FedRAMP High authorized environment, giving them access to Claude's coding and agentic capabilities after a public beta that began in July.

items.headline: Nvidia and CoreWeave close the loop from AI training to production
items.summary: Nvidia and CoreWeave announced the Vera Rubin NVL72 system now running production workloads for Cognition, plus the new Vera CPU built specifically for AI agents and a CoreWeave Forge environment for training and evaluating agentic models.

items.headline: Apple to unveil three Siri-powered smart home products on October 13
items.summary: Apple is set to debut a long-awaited smart home hub, a new HomePod mini and an updated Apple TV, all built around its revamped Siri AI, after years of delay tied to the assistant's overhaul.

items.headline: Trump signs "Super Intelligence" executive order as AI leaders ink safety accord
items.summary: President Trump signed an order directing federal agencies to rebrand AI as "Super Intelligence," alongside a voluntary Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities signed by the heads of Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Nvidia and SpaceX pledging internal safety controls for frontier models.

items.headline: Meta launches Muse for Small Business
items.summary: Meta expanded its Muse AI agent into a version aimed at small businesses that can draft ad campaigns, manage inventory and cash flow, and build websites, integrating with tools like Shopify, Canva and Slack as Meta pushes beyond consumer AI.

items.headline: Humanoid robot learns to sprint and perform spin kicks from human motion data
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated a humanoid robot that acquired dynamic athletic movements, including sprinting and spin kicks, by training on human motion-capture data, pushing forward whole-body agility for legged robots.

items.headline: Global sales of professional service robots surge 24%
items.summary: The International Federation of Robotics' World Robotics 2026 report found shipments of professional service robots rose 24% to nearly 250,000 units in 2025, with humanoids emerging as a new category at about 7,000 units and logistics robots leading overall demand.

items.headline: Weekly arXiv digest highlights adaptive LLM architectures and agent safety research
items.summary: A roundup of roughly 50 AI papers submitted this week points to three major research trends: brain-inspired adaptive-depth LLM architectures, runtime safety validation for deployed agents, and efficiency gains in quantization and distillation.
